name: International Doom / Heretic / Hexen 9.1 (2026-10-23)
body:
## International Doom / Heretic / Hexen 9.1

### Features
- Implemented ingame "short tics" toggle key bind, available in Keyboard Bindings / Special Modes / Short tics mode (thanks al_zera).
- Extended the weapon bobbing feature with an "Improved" modes for less repetitive and more natural weapon sway (@pvictress).
- Implemented variable game speed (from 3% to 10000%). Toggling keys can be assigned in the Special Modes section of the Keyboard Bindings menu (@pvictress).
- Implemented **rewind** feature. The rewind key can be assigned in the Special Modes section of the Keyboard Bindings menu; rewind can be configured and disabled on the second page of Misc Settings (@pvictress).
- Implemented "Clean Screenshot" feature; key bind can be assigned in Keyboard Bindings menu (with thanks to **Claire** and @pvictress).
- Added back "unscaled" fuzz effect, available in Gameplay Features / Fuzz Effect (thanks **STARTEK2**).
- Added the ability to choose PNG screenshot compression level, as well as JPEG save support. Available in Misc Features / Screenshots (by @pvictress, with special thanks to Sean Barrett (@nothings)).

### Improvements
- Implemented [Transposed Backbuffer](https://github.com/GooberMan/rum-and-raisin-doom/wiki/Transposed-Backbuffer) rendering for improving rendering performance (@pvictress, with whanks to @GooberMan).
- Implemented "Organize Save Files" and "Organize Screenshots" options to the Misc menu. When enabled, savegames and screenshots go into subfolders named after the WAD the maps were loaded from, instead of the common Savegames/Screenshots folders (@pvictress).
- Heretic and Hexen: interpolated status bar chain movement in uncapped framerate mode (@pvictress).
- Heretic and Hexen: vertical mouse look is now more responsive.
- Heretic and Hexen: added dedicated mouse button binds for all artifacts (thanks ptrdoom).
- Saturation can now be set above 100% (up to 200%), and R/G/B intensity can be increased beyond 1.0 (up to 2.0) (by @pvictress, with thanks to BenAkenobi).
- Improved colors for certain default menu options (thanks BenAkenobi).
- The gamepad is now disabled by default to avoid extra detection/handling calls during program runtime. It can be enabled in Gamepad Settings menu.
- Replaced Nuked-OPL3 with optimized Nuked-OPL3-fast (special thanks to Tony Gies (@tgies)).
- Improved automap mouse panning: should be more responsive now and better working with automap rotate mode (@pvictress).
- Various Doom v1.2 emulation improvements (thanks @mikeday0 and  @SmileTheory).
- Implemented "Shimmering HOM" post-processing effect, with an appearance similar to the DOS version (@pvictress).
- Added "Cylindrical sky projection" to "Sky drawing mode" (@pvictress, with whanks to @MrAlaux).
- Improved performance of sprites drawing/clipping (@pvictress).
- Doom: DeHackEd patches of Chex Quest, French Doom 2 version and Doom 1.2 are now embedded into the executable and no longer require extra downloads (thanks @pvictress, @mikeday0, @fragglet).

### Widgets
- Added DSDA font option for widgets drawing (thanks @pvictress).

### Automap
- Adapted automap tag finder from DSDA-Doom, default keybind is H (@pvictress, with thanks to @kraflab).

### Fixes
- Fixed missing raising/lowering animation on some Dehacked-modded weapons (thanks @andrikpowell).
- Mouse wheel now working with any mouse actions (@pvictress).
- Fixed possible rare crash on changing music tracks in OPL synth (thanks @Noseey).
- Fixed jittering of dropped items on moving lifts (@pvictress, with thanks to @andrikpowell).
- Fixed a few missing tracks in the Remastered Music that caused the program to quit (@pvictress, with thanks to @augvalle).
- Hexen: fixed possible slime trails on polyobjects drawing (@pvictress, with thanks to ptrdoom).

### Linux
- AppImage application icons are now displayed correctly under GNOME environments (@electricbrass).
- AppImage distributions now include .zsync files for update checking and delta updates (thanks @electricbrass).
- Implemented automatic detection of .sf2 soundfonts on Linux (@bubbleguuum).

### Windows library updates
- Updated SDL2 Mixer to version 2.8.2.
- 64-bit only: updated FluidSynth to version 2.6.1.

name: International Doom / Heretic / Hexen 9.0 (2026-03-31)
body:
**Warning:** Save files from version 8.3 and earlier are not compatible with this version.

### Startup Launcher
Implemented a Startup Launcher to help detect IWAD files and launch them without using the command line or drag-and-drop (by @pvictress).

Key features include:

- Command-line arguments, window size, and window position are saved on exit.
- Supports drag-and-drop for `.wad`, `.deh`, `.lmp`, and `.ini` files, which are automatically added to the generated command line.
- The launcher can be enabled or disabled in-game via `Misc Features / Launcher`.

The launcher is currently available only on Windows.
We apologize to our Linux users, but we currently do not have enough expertise to implement the same type of dialog windows on Linux.

### Upgraded TrueColor Rendering
The renderer has received a major upgrade in diminished lighting and support for custom COLORMAP effects. To avoid terminology confusion, the `TrueColor Rendering` option in Video Options has been renamed to `Rendering Mode`, with the following choices:

- Original: Paletted rendering with original diminished lighting, exactly as in the classic games.
- Interpolated: Interpolates the 32 levels of the COLORMAP lump to 256 levels, deriving intermediate steps from the COLORMAP lump itself. This mode is fully compatible with brightmap effects from custom COLORMAPs.
- TrueColor: Interpolates the 32 levels of the COLORMAP lump to 256 levels using only the first and last rows of the COLORMAP lump. This mode provides smoother diminished lighting but, due to relying only on the first and last rows, may not be fully compatible with certain custom effects.

All modes now pass the renderer validation tests in KDiKDiZD (by @pvictress, with special thanks to @MrAlaux).

### Gamepad Support
- Added in-game gamepad support, bindings, and runtime detection in `Controls Settings / Gamepad Settings` (thanks @pvictress).

### Features
- Implemented a per-column sprite lighting feature, available in `Gameplay Features / Visual` (by @pvictress, with thanks to @WhiteMagicRaven).
- Implemented a sprite shadows feature, available in `Gameplay Features / Visual` (by @pvictress, with special thanks to @bradharding).
- Added save/load thumbnail previews, plus save metadata (by @pvictress).
- The `Level Time` and `Total Time` widgets can now optionally display centiseconds (thanks BenAkenobi).
- Extended the `Colored Blood` gameplay feature with `Green/Blue only` and `All` options (by @pvictress, with thanks to @BitforBitTest).
- The `Secret is Revealed!` message can now be renamed in the configuration file. The `gp_revealed_secrets_msg` variable will appear after the next launch and exit (by @pvictress).
- Restored the message fading effect in `Options / Display / Fading effect`. Fade speed is now adjustable (by @pvictress).
- Pop-up dialog windows now use a dark theme, matching the launcher's design.
- Doom: added support for the `BRGHTMPS` lump, compatible with Woof! and DOOM Retro source ports (by @pvictress).
- Doom: the original screen wipe (melting) effect and the scrolling finale screen with the rabbit in Doom 1 are now interpolated in uncapped framerate mode (by @pvictress).
- Doom and Heretic: implemented `IDDKT` / `IDDIT` / `IDDST` cheat codes (by @pvictress).
- Hexen: implemented weapon attack alignment for all weapons (by @pvictress).

### Improvements
- Added support for dual key/mouse bindings, similar to Quake 1 (thanks BenAkenobi).
- Spectator mode: added mouselook support, proper sound attenuation for the roaming camera, and smoother mouse response when framerate is uncapped (thanks to myk).
- Added a dedicated keybinding to decrease gamma (no default key assigned, as all F-keys are already in use).
- Implemented a savegame compatibility check against the loaded WAD (by @pvictress, with thanks to @fabiangreffrath).
- World sprites are no longer flipped horizontally in `Flipped Levels` mode (by @pvictress).
- PC speaker volume now follows digital sound volume directly (by @pvictress).
- Implemented support for PNG graphics/patches. Both 32-bit and 8-bit PNGs are supported, with conversion to paletted 8-bit where needed (by @pvictress).
- Music: the temporary `doom.mid` file is no longer created when playing MUS/MIDI lumps. Music is now loaded directly from memory, similar to the previously updated digital music playback path (by @pvictress).
- Compatibility: Direct3D 11 scaler is now used only on 64-bit Windows; other platforms use the SDL-selected scaler.
- Heretic and Hexen: closing the game menu no longer forcefully disables an already enabled game pause (by @pvictress, with thanks to @bubbleguuum).
- Heretic and Hexen: graphical startup now renders in the main window, so it can also appear in full-screen mode (by @pvictress).
- Hexen: improved smoothing of sky scrolling. Subtle pixel jitter should be less noticeable now (by @pvictress).

### Rendering
- Fixed sprites disappearing or flickering across BSP sectors (by @pvictress).
- Eliminated right-edge drift/jitter on long walls (by @pvictress).

### Level Select
- Added `Co-op spawns` to `Level Select`; `fast`, `respawning`, and `coop_spawns` settings are now saved in savegames (by @pvictress, with thanks to Uni).

### Automap
- Automap settings (active state, follow mode, and others) are now preserved in savegames.
- Improved anti-aliasing quality for line smoothing (by @pvictress).
- Mouse panning is now smoother and framerate-independent (by @pvictress).

### Minimap
- Implemented a customizable mini-map with fine-tuning options. Settings are available in `Automap Settings / Minimap`. Also added a keybinding for quickly toggling the mini-map on/off under `Keyboard Bindings / Automap` (by @pvictress).

### Fixes
- Fixed GUS music playback not working on Windows 64-bit (thanks BenAkenobi).
- Fixed incorrect negative gamma-correction values (thanks BenAkenobi).
- Fixed incorrect menu cursor position after changing resolution (thanks BenAkenobi).
- Now using standard scrollbars in the `Level Select` menu (thanks BenAkenobi).
- Fixed non-working `-1`...`-4` command-line parameters for screen scaling in windowed mode; added `-5` and `-6` (by @pvictress).
- Screenshots: removed alpha channel to prevent transparent areas, most noticeable on black automap backgrounds (by @pvictress).
- Windows: fixed slightly broken program icons in Windows 10/11 Task Manager (by @pvictress).
- Doom: fixed incorrect fuzz effect when invulnerability and invisibility are active (by @pvictress).
- Doom: fixed incorrect textures appearing in rare cases, e.g. MAP30 in TNT2: Devilution (by @pvictress).
- Heretic: fixed a potential crash when playing sounds with an extended number of SFX channels (thanks Dweller).
- Heretic (Enhanced levels): fixed linedef special 24832 (E2M4, Iron Lich room), which stopped working correctly in Inter after the H+H update.
- Heretic: fixed incorrect colors during crossfade to the underwater finale screen in paletted rendering mode (by @pvictress).
- Heretic: fixed leftover text artifacts after crossfade on the underwater finale screen (by @pvictress).
- Heretic: fixed stray pixels on screen borders in bordered mode (by @pvictress).
- Hexen: retained support for the vanilla `hexen.wad` IWAD (thanks @BitforBitTest).
- Hexen: fixed an issue where reloading a level after launching with `-warp` sent the player to the start map (by @pvictress).
- Hexen: fixed incorrect translucency of fading armor parts on the status bar.
- Hexen: fixed a vanilla bug by locking chain phase to life gem movement to prevent drift while health changes (by @pvictress).
- Hexen: fixed a vanilla oversight where the `SHADOWCASTER` cheat code failed to fully change the player class, leaving player sprite and sounds from the previous class unchanged (by @pvictress).

### FluidSynth
- On 64-bit Windows, if `fsynth_sf_path` is not set, the port now automatically loads the system soundfont from `Windows\System32\Drivers\gm.dls`. This enables MIDI playback via FluidSynth without extra configuration. Custom soundfonts still require an absolute or relative path to an `.sf2` file (by @pvictress).

### Library Updates
- Windows 64-bit: updated FluidSynth to version 2.5.2.

name: Nightly Release
body:
## International Doom / Heretic / Hexen 9.2

### Improvements
* Textures and flats in 32-bit PNG format are now supported (with post-conversion to paletted colors) (@pvictress, with thanks to @bubbleguuum).
* Doom and Heretic: added support for `ANIMDEFS` lump (@pvictress, with thanks to @bubbleguuum).

name: International Doom / Heretic / Hexen 8.3 (2025-09-21)
body:
The project celebrates its ninth anniversary on September 16, 2025! 🎂

### Limited support for H+H Rerelease

Limited support for the H+H rerelease has been implemented, including:
* Support for IWAD files.
* Support for Remastered Music.
* Display of the Kex-style status bar (Gameplay / Status Bar).
* Heretic only: support for enhanced levels (heretic_ex.wad).

Note that support for new mechanics and the Faith Renewed and Vestiges of Grandeur expansions is not provided.

### Translucency

The blending subsystem has received a major update for 8-bit translucency. When TrueColor mode is not enabled, all blending functions (translucent sprites, fuzz and darkening effects, shaded patches, etc.) now operate strictly within the 256-color PLAYPAL palette. This is not a 1:1 implementation of the classic `TRANMAP`/`TINTTAB`, but our own solution that delivers a visually similar result. Special attention was paid to the fuzz effect: it should now be identical to the original palette renderer. 

### Remastered Music

Simplified loading of WAD files with Remastered Music – if the D1+D2 and/or H+H rereleases are properly installed on the system, or music files are placed in the port folder, the port will automatically detect the WAD files with music, load them, and make them available in Sound Options. Therefore, using the `-file` parameter or placing WAD files in autoload will no longer be required. 

### Widgets
* Implemented player speed widget (by @pvictress, with thanks to @ceski-1).

### Automap
* Added support for automap panning via mouse input. Disabled by default to preserve vanilla behavior; can be enabled in Automap Settings or bound to a hotkey (by @pvictress).
* Heretic & Hexen: player arrow now glowing while in Spectator mode in automap.
* Heretic & Hexen: implemented "black" automap background.
* Heretic & Hexen: restored back-line fading near the edges of the screen (by @pvictress, with thanks to @OpenRift412).
* Hexen: when the status bar and automap are active, the key and armor bar will always be shown to match the original behavior. Additionally, armor part icons will now be properly redrawn according to changes in armor values (thanks @electricbrass).

### Gameplay Features
* Doom: added optional "Intercepts Overflow" fix into Compatibility-breaking section. 
* Hexen: implemented "percent" value for armor drawing.

### Improvements
* Better interpolation for animated weapon states in uncapped framerate mode (thanks @fabiangreffrath and @rfomin).
* Increased the number of save game pages to 16 (by @pvictress).
* Overbright Glow post-processing effect no longer applied in Doom and Heretic while invulnerability effect and in Hexen on foggy levels.
* Implemented "Switch Soundtrack" key bind (off/remix/default), available in Shortcut Keys section.
* Implemented "Go to previous level" key bind, available in Special Keys section (by @pvictress).
* Doom: fuzz effect is now always drawing as "blocky" and independent from rendering resolution (by @pvictress, with thanks to @fabiangreffrath).
* Doom: added minimal support for multiple skies in Doom 1 + Doom 2 release (like in MAP20, thanks @Meerschweinmann).
* Doom & Heretic: the items counter on the KIS widget is now optional and can be disabled via Show items in the Widgets settings.
* Heretic & Hexen: changing the music playback system no longer requires a restart (by @pvictress).
* Hexen: replaced additive translucency with regular blending on foggy levels to improve visual consistency (by @pvictress).
* Hexen: included own icon for Deathkings of the Dark Citadel into Windows executable (by @pvictress).
* Hexen: implemented "Maximum quake intensity factor" in Misc Features / Accessibility section.
* Hexen: removed original pointless ~0.3 sec delay on changing levels!
* Other small technical and performance improvements (by @pvictress, with thanks to @bubbleguuum).

### Fixes
* Mouse wheel now working for "use" action (by @pvictress).
* Fixed simultaneous automap panning and zooming (by @pvictress).
* Fixed texture curving on ceiling visplanes in wide screen modes (by @pvictress).
* Fixed missing space between K and I in the "K/I/S" counter's Ratio mode when a large number of extra kills is shown (by @pvictress).
* Fixed mouse-driven menu navigation for non-corrected aspect ratios (i.e. vid_aspect_ratio_correct = 0 or 2) (by @pvictress).
* Doom: improved Z-axis sound attenuation, fixing missing sounds from moving tall sectors (e.g. TNT MAP16).
* Heretic: fixed a crash when seg references missing sidedef on level loading (by @pvictress, with thanks to @kitchen-ace).
* Heretic & Hexen: fixed unavailable "Overlay shading level" menu item in Automap options.
* Hexen: fixed animated flats incorrectly showing liquid animation.
* Hexen: fixed possible display of pain/bonus/poison palette effect on the finale text screen.

### Libraries update
* Windows: Updated SDL to version 2.32.10.

_Compiled using Visual Studio Build Tools 2022, version 17.14.15._

name: International Doom / Heretic / Hexen 8.2 (2025-05-25)
body:
### Post-processing effects

Post-processing effects — a new section available in the Video Options menu. It provides a collection of visual filters designed to adjust the final image with finer control and aesthetic enhancements.

These effects are subtle by design. However, please note that all processing is done on the CPU, within the limits of a single-threaded software renderer. As such, enabling multiple effects may impact performance, especially on lower-end systems.

Special thanks to @pvictress for implementing, fine-tuning, and polishing the majority of these effects with exceptional attention to detail.

### Improvements
* New app icons (by @pvictress).
* Improved menu controls by mouse (thanks @electricbrass and @pvictress), and improved hovering glow effects.
* Added vertical mouse sensitivity option in Control Settings menu (thanks @electricbrass).
* Added "static" menu highlighting effect in Misc Features menu.
* Implemented left/status bar/auto widgets alignment in Widgets Settings menu.
* Improved animated liquids feature: new animation effects for blood, slime, lava and sludge surfaces (thanks @pvictress).
* Doom only: added new screen wipe effect - fizzle (by @pvictress).
* Doom only: added new Gameplay / Status Bar feature - full screen layout, with available Remaster (thanks @liPillON) and Doom64 inspired layouts.
* Other technical improvements. Notably, translucency drawing should be much faster now.

### Fixes
* Fixed inability to change monsters on casting screen in Doom 2 (thanks @Meerschweinmann).
* Heretic: Tutti-Frutti fix now working on sky textures with any height (thanks @mikeday0).
* Heretic & Hexen: fix music not resuming after loading a paused savegame with same track (by @pvictress).

### Windows libraries update
* Updated SDL to version 2.32.6.
* Updated SDL Mixer to version 2.8.1.
* Updated FluidSynth to version 2.4.6 (win-64 version only).

_Compiled using Visual Studio Build Tools 2022, version 17.14.2._

name: International Doom / Heretic / Hexen 8.1 (2025-01-25)
body:
### Renderer
* Numerous performance optimizations in rendering, drawing, and translucency blending functions (by @pvictress).
* Added "Exclusive Fullscreen" mode, available in Rendering Options.
* Windows: Changed the default screen scale API to Direct3D 11.

### Improvements
* Added mouse control for menus (thanks @pvictress).
* Added auto-detection for Unity and Doom 1+2 IWAD search folders (thanks @rfomin and @NightFright2k19).
* Improved color intensity and saturation handling logic (by @pvictress, with thanks to @MrAlaux).
* Implemented contrast adjustment, available in Display Options (by @pvictress).
* Local time widget now consistently displays AM/PM, regardless of the system locale (by @pvictress).
* Restored grayscale fuzz effect ("B&W"), now resource-independent and mod-friendly (thanks @pvictress).
* Applied color corrections to palette flash effects (by @pvictress).
* Digital music lumps are now read directly from memory, without needing extraction to the system temp folder (by @pvictress).
* Fixed minimal window size behavior: it is no longer affected by rendering resolution, and the window size remains consistent after increasing resolution and restarting the program (thanks @rfomin).
* Improved smoothness of "smooth" fake contrast mode on angled walls (by @pvictress).
* Added support for drag-n-drop WAD/DEH files onto the executable file on Linux (by @pvictress, with thanks to @fabiangreffrath).

### Widgets
* Added customizable color schemes for widgets (thanks **Uni**).
* Implemented multiple display formats for KIS stats (by @pvictress, with thanks to **Uni**).

### Automap
* Implemented adjustable automap line thickness. Available sizes are: "1x–6x" and "auto" (by @pvictress).

### New "Miscellaneous Features" Menu
A new submenu is now available in Options, containing various uncategorized settings. Note: none of these options change existing port behavior. The menu includes settings for:
* **Accessibility**: Options for invulnerability effect, palette flash effects, movement and weapon bobbing amplitudes, and colorblind filters (ported from Chocorenderlimits/CRL, thanks @pvictress).
* **Autoload**: Controls whether WAD and DEH files should be auto-loaded and if PWAD-named folders should be created (thanks @Meerschweinmann).
* **Menu Settings**: Additional fine-tuning options.

### Support for remastered music from `extras.wad`
* If `extras.wad` from Doom 1+2 is loaded via `-file`, auto-loaded, or dragged and dropped onto the executable, the "Preferred Soundtrack" option in the Sound Options menu will allow switching between "Remix," "Original," or "Off." If `extras.wad` is not loaded, the option will remain forced to "Off" (special thanks to @Meerschweinmann).

Note: this feature does not provide support for `TRAKINFO` lump.

### Fixes
* Resolved an issue where the player would unintentionally fire a weapon when loading a save game with the left mouse button while moving the mouse.
* Fixed writing incorrect data to the footer during demo recording and level restart (thanks @rfomin and **gera**).

### Library Updates
* Updated SDL to version 2.30.11.
* Updated FluidSynth to version 2.4.2.

_Compiled using Visual Studio Build Tools 2022, version 17.12.4._

name: International Doom / Heretic / Hexen 8.0 (2024-10-06)
body:
This is a next major version with technical improvements and few eye-candy features. ### Compiled with Build Tools for Visual Studio 2022 Kind thanks to @rfomin for a lot of help with Visual Studio and **insellium** for raising the issue of Windows XP support! * Win64 version: compiled as statically linked executable, so additional .dll files are no longer needed and existing ones from previous versions can be safely removed. * Win32 version: still using .dll dependent approach, but now compatible with Windows XP.
_Note for XP users: [Service Pack 3](https://www.catalog.update.microsoft.com/Search.aspx?q=XP%20service%20pack%203) and [Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2019](https://download.visualstudio.microsoft.com/download/pr/566435ac-4e1c-434b-b93f-aecc71e8cffc/0D59EC7FDBF05DE813736BF875CEA5C894FFF4769F60E32E87BD48406BBF0A3A/VC_redist.x86.exe) Redistributable for x86 systems are required. SSE2 compatible CPU is required as well._ ### Features * Significantly improved smoothing of "Diminished Lighting: Smooth" in TrueColor rendering. * Added "Palette Fading Effect" feature to make the fading effects smoother. This also affects berserk fade in Doom; Wraithwerge, Bloodscourge and poison palette in Hexen. * Added back "Sound of crushed corpse" feature, but now it's using stock IWAD `DSSLOP` sound. * "Items are tossed when dropped" gameplay feature now working. * Implemented intermediate brighter gamma-correction levels. * Added `-levelstat` command line parameter for Doom (thanks @kraflab, @fabiangreffrath and @xemonix0). * Added "Square Aspect Ratio" feature to Automap Setting (shamelessly taken from Woof! Thanks @thearst3rd). ### Improvements * Better sprite clipping for higher field of view settings and wider aspect ratios (thanks @ceski-1). * Even better precision for patch drawing functions on higher wide screen modes, [Ultra-Widerpix854](https://www.doomworld.com/forum/topic/148537-ultra-widerpix854-329-super-ultrawide-assets-for-the-doom-and-raven-games/?tab=comments#comment-2855640) 32:9 wide screen assets now working correctly (thanks @rfomin and @Meerschweinmann). * Added dedicated "Speed On" mouse button, added names for mouse wheels and slightly reordered mouse bindings menu (thanks **Dweller Dark**). * Fixed sector's sound origin for large levels (thanks @kitchen-ace). * Gameplay Features pages can be scrolled via arrow keys when cursor is placed on `< Scroll pages >` item. * Improved coloring accuracy of Jaguar automap color scheme. * Other small technical improvements. ### Fixes * Path to GUS patches folder now may contain spaces (thanks @mikeday0). * Hexen: fixed possible incorrect save game deletion (thanks @mikeday0). * Heretic and Hexen: fixed incorrect automap line anti-aliasing when toggled in the game menu. ### Libraries update * Updated SDL library to version 2.30.8.

name: International Doom 7.5 / Heretic 7.1 / Hexen 7.1 (2024-06-29)
body:
### Controls
* Added  fast mouse polling for lower lag interpolation at uncapped frame rate (thanks @ceski-1, @mikeday0 and @rfomin).
* Mouse movement while the mouse button is held down in the active menu is no longer considered an extra key press.
* Player will no longer automatically press `use` when entering a new level after skipping intermission texts by pressing `use`.
* Added a special bind for toggling the extended HUD, available in the Keyboard Binds / Special Keys section (toggles all enabled on-screen widgets and the demo bar, thanks @Catoptromancy and Aurelius).
* Level reload / Go to next level from tally screen now possible.

### Video
* Improved support for UltraWide screen modes at higher render resolutions. Added 32:9 widescreen mode to the Video Options menu, as it is now properly supported. (thanks @Meerschweinmann).
* Improved stability and precision of full-screen patch drawing at higher render resolutions (thanks @Meerschweinmann).
* Added "Crossfade" for "Screen wiping effect".

### Other improvements
* Save and Load menu now shows date and time of save game file (thanks @fabiangreffrath).
* Added `savegames_path`, `screenshots_path` config variables and `-shotdir` command line parameter (thanks @liPillON).
* Single sided automap lines now appearing last in drawing order (Woof! issue [#1665](https://github.com/fabiangreffrath/woof/issues/1665). Thanks @ribbiks, @rfomin and @fabiangreffrath).
* "Mark secret sectors" will now always show secret sectors after they've been found on the automap, and optionally before as well (by @kitchen-ace, thanks!).
* Extended "Show ENDOOM" to "PWAD only".
* Quick load before quick save now possible (thanks @fabiangreffrath).
* Updated program icons to 256x256 size.

### Doom only
* Added back `-complevel N` command line parameter to emulate a specific version of Doom engine executable. Supported complevels are `0`, `1`, `2`, `3` and `4`.

### Heretic only
* Added back support for graphical startup, available in Video Options menu.

### Hexen only
* Extra translucency of Quietus' green clouds has been disabled, as they can cause serious framerate drops on point-blank attacks.

### Libraries update
* Updated SDL library to version 2.30.4 and FluidSynth to version 2.3.5

_Compiled using GCC 14.1.0﻿ under MSYS﻿﻿ environment._

name: International Doom 7.4 (2023-03-08)
body:
### Video

* Improved True color code for better compatibility of drawing graphical patches when `PLAYPAL` and `COLORMAP` lumps have different color indexes. (thanks @fabiangreffrath)
* Reduced memory consumption of screen border drawing when using bordered screen sizes (thanks @rfomin).

### Automap
* Automap can be zoomed in/out by using mouse wheel (thanks @NightFright2k19).
* Marks properly cleared after finishing the level (thanks @NightFright2k19).
* Zooming in/out by pressing `+` and `-` interpolated again in uncapped frame rate mode.

### New features
* Added mouse look option to Control settings (thanks @Meerschweinmann).
* Added dedicated bind for toggling vertical mouse movement (thanks @kitchen-ace).
* Implemented "On Death Action" feature, available in Gameplay section of Gameplay Features menu.

### Other improvements
* `Y`-type actions can be by confirmed by left mouse button, `N`-type actions can be confirmed by right mouse button.
* Starting game in nightmare skill, end game and quit can be confirmed by Enter key.
* Added proper support for wide status bar graphics with `0` horizontal offset (thanks @NightFright2k19).
* Added support dedicated music tracks for the 4th episode (thanks **Horizon**).
* Fixed possible demo desync when floating powerups modified by Dehacked (thanks @Meerschweinmann).
* Empty save game slots now prefilled with map name on game saving (thanks @NightFright2k19).
* Improved detection for chex.deh (thanks @NightFright2k19).
* Background shading now covers all game menus, blinking no longer happening while active menu and uncapped game state (thanks @NightFright2k19).
* Chosen player view no longer resets to first player in multiplayer demo playback.
* `-warp` command line parameter can be used without spaces in Doom 1, i.e. `-warp 23` will warp to 2nd episode and 3rd level (thanks @fabiangreffrath).
* Monsters forget player after use of notarget cheat.
* Vanilla menu strings now have highlighting/fading effect.
* Fixed vanilla bug of blinking Tower of Babel level on intermission screen when switching to "Entering" state.

### Libraries update
* Updated SDL to version 2.30.0.
* Updated SDL Mixer to version 2.8.0. This version fixes FLAC music looping critical issue.

name: International Hexen 7.0 (2024-03-08)
body:
Just like it was done to Doom, this is a next major version, a total refresh. Whole project has been reviewed, rewritten and reassembled, as well as all resource dependency and "bloat" features has been removed.

This project couldn't be possible to exist without @fabiangreffrath, @rfomin, @mikeday0, @ceski-1 and @bradharding, as well as @kitchen-ace, @Meerschweinmann and @NightFright2k19!

name: International Doom 7.3 (2023-12-31)
body:
### Improvements
- Added support for x3, x5 and x6 rendering resolutions (thanks @fabiangreffrath, @MrAlaux and @Meerschweinmann).
- Switching between rendering resolutions and widescreen modes now fast and painless.
- Added support for Sigil II (thanks @mikeday0 and @ceski-1)
- Brightmaps now applied to translucent and color-translated sprites.
- Added dedicated keyboard bind for making 180° degree turn in Movement section (thanks @fabiangreffrath).
- Added support for variable FOV, available in the Display Options menu. Available range is from 45 to 135, default value is 90 (thanks @bradharding, @rfomin, @MrAlaux and **CacoKnight**).
- Added support for «SSG in Doom 1» feature (thanks @fabiangreffrath and **CacoKnight**).
- Disabled `doom-all` autoload for Freedoom.
- Small technical and performance improvements.

### Demos
- Added various enhancements for demo recording from Crispy Doom (thanks @fabiangreffrath):
  - Demo info footer. 
  - Prevention of overriding demos by adding a "-NNNNN" file name suffix.
  - Ability to "join demo" (i.e. giving controls to the player and continue recording).
- Improved "Special Keys" handling while demo playback:
  - Pressing "Restart level/demo" now restarts demo and keeps it playing.
  - Pressing "Go to next level" now goes to next level of demo and keeps it playing.
- Frame rate no longer forcefully uncapped after using demo warp (i.e. `-playdemo demo.lmp -warp 18`) if vertical sync is enabled.
- `IDCLEV` cheat code now working in demo playback (thanks @fabiangreffrath). Additionally, it is possible to go previous levels, not just next ones.
- Demo warping should be a little bit faster now.
- Demo bar colors is now independent from game palette, always showing black and white colors.

### Libraries update
- Updated SDL to version 2.28.5.

name: International Doom 7.2.1 (2023-10-29)
body:
### Improvements
- Gray `0` and `5` are now properly recognized in keyboard bindings and side/extra mouse buttons are now properly recognized in the mouse bindings menu.
- IDDQD cheat code: fixed reviving if god mode was already enabled ([#1106](https://github.com/fabiangreffrath/crispy-doom/pull/1106), thanks @tomas7770).

### Source code
- Almost the entire codebase has been updated to the latest Chocolate/Crispy Doom code. This includes numerous fixes and stability improvements.
- Enabled ASan as a compile-time option (see `ENABLE_ASAN` in `/CMakeLists.txt` file, may not work with GCC, need Clang), fixed all remaining "pedantic" warnings in GCC 13.2.0 and 17.0.2, and separated platform-dependent sources at compile-time (thanks @rfomin).

name: International Doom 7.2 (2023-10-22)
body:
### Improvements
- Better color translation from cyan to green (thanks @fabiangreffrath and @liPillON).
- Disabled sector special 17 in `gameversion 1.2` ([#1554](https://github.com/chocolate-doom/chocolate-doom/pull/1554), thanks @tpoppins).
- Playing demos with multiple levels is now possible with Pistol Start game mode enabled. 
- Renamed Fake Contrast from "On" to "Original" for better compliance with other menu items (thanks @OpenRift412).
- Player movement and camera rotation no longer possible while active game menu in multiplayer game.
- Improved messages ticker handling.
- "Centered" message of revealed secret will be shown if messages are off, to work with same logics as "top" placement.
- Blinking key or skull on status bar now optional and disabled by default to match up default port setting. Feature can be enabled back in Gameplay Features / Status Bar.
- Added `fsynth_gain` config file variable to fine tune the FluidSynth output level (thanks @fabiangreffrath and @Vitoria90).
- Improved support for tall skies and it's stretching ([#1092](https://github.com/fabiangreffrath/crispy-doom/issues/1092), thanks @fabiangreffrath and @kitchen-ace).
- Improved support for `DEHACKED` lump loading from PWAD ([#1101](https://github.com/fabiangreffrath/crispy-doom/issues/1101), thanks @fabiangreffrath and @kitchen-ace).

### Fixes
- Fixed possible errors and silent crashes on toggling video options (thanks @MrAlaux).
- Fixed possible random silent crash on visplanes drawing.

### Demos
- Gameplay-unsafe cheats now disabled while demo playing/recording. Safe ones `IDMUS`, `IDDT` and `IDMYPOS` are still allowed (thanks @fabiangreffrath).
- An ingame message "Demo recording: _demoname.lmp_" will be printed right after the start with demo recording.

### Available again
- Level Name widget (automap only / always). Can be useful while demo watching.

### Windows OS only 
- Added support for drag-n-drop .ini config files onto the executable.
- Windows 11: Snipping Tool no longer appears after pressing <kbd>PrintScreen</kbd> key (thanks @bradharding). <kbd>Win+Shift+S</kbd> combination will work as usual for this case.

### Libraries update
- Updated SDL to version 2.28.4.
- Updated FluidSynth to version 2.3.4.
- Updated included MinGW libraries to their actual versions.

_Compiled using GCC 13.2.0﻿ under MSYS﻿﻿ environment._

name: International Doom 7.1 (2023-09-16)
body:
Seventh anniversary of the project! 🎂

### Improvements
- "Translucency" feature extended to "Additive" (current implementation) and "Blending" (more classical look) modes.
- "Revealed secret message" feature extended to "Top" (current implementation) and "Centered".
- Added "Reset bindings to default" function to mouse bindings menu.
- Fixed [status bar face hysteresis](https://doomwiki.org/wiki/Status_bar_face_hysteresis) when player is going invulnerable from pain/ouch states.
- Reorder sprites rendering, so that objects with higher map indices appear in front (thanks @fabiangreffrath).
- Various small improvements for brightmaps:
  - Improved lighting of armor bonus, BFG9000 (world and HUD sprites) and `SW2STONE` texture for Doom 1.
  - Fixed incorrect brightmapping on armor bonuses, explosive barrels and rarely on floor textures in some instances.
  - Excluded TNT brightmaps when not using tnt.wad (thanks @kitchen-ace and @fabiangreffrath).
- Various small technical improvements (also thanks @rfomin).
- Upgraded SDL library to version 2.28.3.

### Available again
- Color Settings subsection for fine-tuning color saturation and RGB intensity, available in Display Options menu.
- Wider status bar modes in wide screen rendering.
- Crosshairs are back in Gameplay Features menu, but with fewer options.
- "Translucent" style for fuzz effect.

### Fixes
- Fixed possible silent crash on toggling hires/widescreen modes while demo playing or network game.
- Added back fixed sound attenuation on Doom 2 map 8.
- Fixed marks drawing on automap in wide screen modes.
- Fixed PIT_ApplyTorque when line has no length (thanks @kraflab).
- [Windows only] Improved drag-n-drop support of files onto executable.

_Compiled using GCC 13.2.0﻿ under MSYS﻿﻿ environment._

name: International Doom 7.0 (2023-07-07)
body:
This is a next major version, a total refresh. Whole project has been reassembled almost from scratch, as well as most of functions and features were either rewritten or replaced with better implementations. I have entirely removed all resource dependency, including translation and beta/jaguar game modes. Uncanonical UNM skill level, bloat "features for features, not for functionality" and unsafe quirks in game mechanics were also removed (with few optional exceptions, which are sill safe for demos/multiplayer).

I'm also leaving any farther development of Heretic and Hexen, as well as previous resource-dependent [codebase](https://github.com/JNechaevsky/inter-doom). It was a good time and practice, but later was giving me nothing more than headache with compatibility and double amount of work, so neither I would like to keep nor maintain it, preferring to keep things clean and simple, just like it was done in my CRL experience.

Please note, this version is not compatible in any ways with previous ones, so yet another clean install is needed.

### Video/Render
- Added optional True Color rendering, a Masterwork written by @fabiangreffrath for Crispy Doom. However, I'm kindly asking to carefully read the first paragraph in [Crispy Doom Wiki](https://github.com/fabiangreffrath/crispy-doom/wiki/FAQ), as everything applies here as well.
- Toggling video options no longer require restart of the program.
- Additional optimization to visplanes drawing.
- Replaced "Loading" screen wipe effect with "Fast".
- Gamma-correction levels OFF-4 now equals to vanilla Doom.

My subjective recommendation for True Color render: try to disable fake contrast and enable smooth diminished lighting in Gameplay Features. This will probably provide best looking, and if game feels brighter than it should, adjust gamma-correction via `F11` key.

### Audio
- Changing music playback system no longer needed for playing tracks in MP3/OGG/FLAC/IT/XM/MOD formats.
- Added FluidSynth support. There is no sample bank included, but I highly recommending to check out [Trevor0402's SC-55 soundfont](https://www.doomworld.com/forum/topic/118828-trevor0402s-sc-55-soundfont/). Just provide a file name or full patch to sound bank in `fsynth_sf_path` config file variable (thanks @rfomin and @mikeday0).
- Upgraded Windows MIDI code (thanks @ceski-1).
- Added support for Chocolate/Crispy Doom compatible music pack folder (`music_pack_path` config file variable).

### Automap
- All automap colors/schemas now more friendly with heavily modified custom palettes.
- Added ReMood/CRL-inspired IDDT cheat monsters highlighting.

### Multiplayer
- Port now compatible with Chocolate/Crispy Doom and Woof (in vanilla complevel) source ports multiplayer.
- Setup executable is back as multiplayer launcher, on same manner as in Woof source port.

### Dehacked
- Port now using actual version of Dehacked parser. Notably, [BFG2704](https://www.doomworld.com/forum/topic/72460-beta-bfg-2704-dehacked-enabler/) is working.

### Chocorenderlimits/CRL features
- Spectator mode - allows to fly around as spectator (thanks @RestlessRodent).
- Freeze mode (cheat shortcut: `FREEZE`) - freezes whole game world except player. 

Shortcut keybinds are available in keyboard bindings / special modes section. 

### Technical
- Added support for drag-n-drop of iwad/pwad/deh/bex files and demo lumps onto executable.
- Added support for Chocolate/Crispy Doom compatible directory based autoload folder (`autoload_path` config file variable).
- Default port values now matches up vanilla Doom (exception: hires rendering).
- Upgraded SDL library to version 2.28.1.
